overview:
Firming Body Massage Oil with Collagen Anti Sagging Smoothing Cellulite Improve Skin Texture Refreshing Body Oil for Legs & Full Body




Specifications:

●Condition: 100% brand new and high quality
●Item Type: Anti Cellulite Massage Oil
●Content: 240ml Boxed
●Shelf life: 3 years
●Storage method: Store in a cool dry place
●Skin Type: Suitable for all skin types
●Target Area: Body (Legs, Thighs, Abdomen, Arms)
●Key Ingredients: Collagen, Grapeseed Oil, Eucalyptus Oil, Lemon Oil, Grapefruit Oil, Plant Extracts




Features:

【Anti-Cellulite Formula】 Specially designed to target stubborn cellulite, helping to smooth and firm the skin’s surface for a more toned appearance.

【Collagen & Plant Extract Infused】 Enriched with collagen to improve skin elasticity, combined with natural plant extracts to deeply nourish and revitalize the skin.

【Natural Oil Blend】 Formulated with grapeseed, eucalyptus, lemon, and grapefruit oils. These ingredients work together to promote circulation, provide antioxidant protection, and leave a refreshing, invigorating scent.

【Non-Greasy Texture】 Lightweight and easily absorbable texture that glides smoothly during massage without leaving a sticky or greasy residue.

【Spa-Quality Care】 Ideal for professional salon use or at-home massage, offering a relaxing spa experience while enhancing skin firmness.




How to use:

1.Apply an appropriate amount of oil to the target area (such as thighs, buttocks, abdomen, or arms).
2.Use firm, circular motions to massage the area for 5–10 minutes until the oil is fully absorbed.
3.For best results, use daily in combination with proper diet and exercise.




When to Use:

Morning or Evening: Use during your daily skincare routine.
After Showering: Apply to slightly damp skin for enhanced absorption.
Before Exercise: Helps warm up muscles and promotes circulation.
Whenever Skin Feels Dry or Lumpy: Use as needed to maintain smoothness and hydration.




Package Includes:

1/2/3Pcs x Anti-Cellulite Massage Oil (240ml)
